title: Brobdingnagian matrices
text: verify matrix multiplication carrying operation two different ways. First, create two largish Brobdingnagian matrices: Now calculate matrix product coercing numeric matrices using base R matrix multiplication: Secondly, use Brobdingnagian matrix multiplication, coercing numeric: difference: small. Now way: see difference exp(-30.267) (7×10−147\times 10^{-14}), small.
code: nrows <- 11 ncols <- 18 M3 <- brobmat(rnorm(nrows*ncols),nrows,ncols,positive=sample(c(T,F),nrows*ncols,replace=T)) M4 <- brobmat(rnorm(nrows*ncols),ncols,nrows,positive=sample(c(T,F),nrows*ncols,replace=T)) M3[1:3,1:3] #>      [,1]          [,2]          [,3]          #> [1,] +exp(-1.4)    -exp(0.62898) -exp(-1.3045) #> [2,] -exp(0.25532) +exp(2.065)   -exp(0.73778) #> [3,] -exp(-2.4373) +exp(-1.631)  +exp(1.8885) p1 <- as.matrix(M3) %*% as.matrix(M4) p2 <- as.matrix(M3 %*% M4) max(abs(p1-p2)) #> [1] 8.526513e-14 q1 <- M3 %*% M4 q2 <- as.brobmat(as.matrix(M3) %*% as.matrix(M4)) max(abs(as.brob(q1-q2))) #> [1] +exp(-30.245)

what: Numerical verification: integration with the cubature package
title: Brobdingnagian matrices
text: matrix functionality Brobdingnag package originally written leverage functionality cubature package. give numerical verification . Suppose wish evaluate ∫x=0x=4(x2−4)dx \int_{x=0}^{x=4}(x^2-4)\,dx using numerical methods. See integrand includes positive negative values; theoretical value 163=5.33…\frac{16}{3}=5.33\ldots. cubature idiom Brobdingnagian equivalent may compare two methods:
code: library("cubature")  f.numeric <- function(x){x^2 - 4}  out.num <- cubature::hcubature(f = f.numeric, lowerLimit = 0, upperLimit = 4, vectorInterface = TRUE) out.num #> $integral #> [1] 5.333333 #>  #> $error #> [1] 1.763322e-13 #>  #> $functionEvaluations #> [1] 15 #>  #> $returnCode #> [1] 0 f.brob <- function(x) {     x <- as.brob(x[1, ])     as.matrix( brobmat(x^2 - 4, ncol = length(x))) }  out.brob <- cubature::hcubature(f = f.brob, lowerLimit = 0, upperLimit = 4, vectorInterface = TRUE) out.brob #> $integral #> [1] 5.333333 #>  #> $error #> [1] 1.763322e-13 #>  #> $functionEvaluations #> [1] 15 #>  #> $returnCode #> [1] 0 out.brob$integral - out.num$integral #> [1] 8.881784e-16
